stem.text: The graph shows the effect of an enzyme on a reaction.

stem.alt: Graph of energy against time with two curves, labelled X (dotted) and Y (dashed), a key, and labels substrate, product, W and Z

A.text: X is the reaction without the enzyme, W is the activation energy.

B.text: X is the reaction with the enzyme, Z is the overall energy change.

C.text: Y is the reaction with the enzyme, W is the difference in activation energy.

D.text: Z is the energy gained by the product, W is the activation energy with the enzyme.
